purpose: The reaction picker of a ReactionGroup: a toolbar of ghost icon buttons on an overlay surface that opens above the trigger and closes when an option is picked.

notFor.case: A general popover with arbitrary content.

Open=true.visual: Surface/layer-2 overlay with a Border/default edge; one ghost secondary IconButton per reaction.

Open=false.meaning: Closed, after a pick, Escape or an outside click.

a11y.role: toolbar with a roving tabindex, inside a non-modal Radix Popover
a11y.keyboard: Arrow keys move and wrap, Home and End jump, Enter or Space picks, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; Tab moves through the content.
notes: Focus moves into the picker on open and back to the trigger on close.
Enters on popover-enter and leaves on popover-exit.

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should popover-enter / popover-exit keep only the fade (as SplitButton's menu does), or follow the shortened tokens?
